read.thesis: Trane Q3 2024: organic revenue up 11%, bookings $5.2B near record with backlog $7.2B, FY organic guide raised to ~11% and EPS to ~$11.10, but China volumes down ~22 points on credit tightening.

triggers.label: FY24 organic revenue guide 10% → ~11%
triggers.quote: we're raising our organic revenue guidance to approximately 11% from our prior guide of 10%

triggers.label: Organic bookings $5.2B, backlog $7.2B
triggers.quote: backlog also remains very strong at $7.2 billion, up from $6.9 billion at year-end 2023

triggers.label: China volumes down ~22 points
triggers.quote: In our Asia Pacific segment, volumes declined by approximately 22 points.

triggers.label: A2L pricing up high-single-digit
triggers.quote: think of the introduced pricing for the new refrigerant products really being up in the high-single-digit range

guidance.quote: we're raising our organic revenue guidance to approximately 11% from our prior guide of 10%
we're raising our full year adjusted earnings per share guidance by $0.30 to approximately $11.10
We expect full year organic leverage of approximately 30%, up from our prior guidance of 25% more.
For the fourth quarter, we expect organic revenue growth of approximately 7% and adjusted EPS of approximately $2.50.

guidance.value: 100% or greater of adjusted net earnings
guidance.quote: We continue to expect free cash flow conversion to adjusted net earnings of 100% or greater.

red_flags.label: China credit tightening, volumes down ~22 points
red_flags.quote: we made the prudent decision to tighten our credit policies in China, primarily related to downpayments and progress payments

evasions.quote: I don't know, is it 50-50, maybe it's a little bit more weighted to policy change at least in the short term
